# netbox_group (Data Source)

Retrieves a single group from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_group" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

output "group_id" {
  value = data.netbox_group.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the group.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A description of the group.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `permissions` (List of Number) The IDs of the permissions of the group.
- `user_count` (Number) The number of user of the group.
